hand_raised.script:
local out = {}
for _, o in ipairs(objects) do
  if o.tracker_id then
    for _, side in ipairs({"left", "right"}) do
      local wrist, shoulder = o.kp[side .. "_wrist"], o.kp[side .. "_shoulder"]
      local up = pose.visible(wrist) and pose.visible(shoulder) and wrist.y < shoulder.y
      local key = o.tracker_id .. ":" .. side
      if once(key, held(key, up, 0.4), 1.0) then
        out[#out + 1] = {event = "hand_raised", action = side, tracker_id = o.tracker_id, class_name = o.class_name}
      end
    end
  end
end
return out
